scene.note: One pattern names a whole group of files, and one command moves them all.

steps.note: Maeve's new drawings are mixed in with invoices and lists in downloads.
Every drawing's name ends the same way, so a pattern can pick them out by their ending.
Listed first, the matching names are only the drawings, nothing else.
One move takes them all to artwork, and downloads keeps everything else.
The March invoices sit in downloads beside other spreadsheets.
The ending is shared with files that are not invoices, so the pattern has to use how the names start.
Listed first, the matching names are the three invoices and no other spreadsheet.
They join the March invoices Idris already has.
Idris wants every Pellow Bakery order in one folder of its own inside orders.
Order names start alike and end with the customer, so the pattern fixes the end and leaves the number free.
Listed first, the matching names are only Pellow Bakery's orders.
They move into the new folder, and the other customers' orders stay put.
